shots.notes: 16 s, lived in: up from black (0.7-3.2 s, frames 30-90; baked in, drop the still's brightness grade), the room sits in lamp and monitor light with rain on the window and a car's lights sweeping the wall (frames 107-159), then one slow approach from the wide (frame 133) that lands framed on the monitor by frame 368 for the cut to the full-screen PC. Covers both s1 stills; full frame, no cam crop. 1920x1080, 12 samples.

Theo's BACK OFFICE key drops in from above frame and lands on the keyboard on the key_tap (38.59) with a small bounce, the tag settling after; the desk lamp clicks off on lamp_click (39.79) and the room drops to the monitor's glow (baked in: drop the still's brightness grade). Slow push toward the key.

Held on the desk. Thursday night with the lamp off (as s2 ends) to frame 43; a blue dawn rakes in and blooms to white (props swap inside the bloom at frame 91); Monday 08:52 settles by frame 115 and holds to the end (the Monday desk, SHOTLIST 3.2). Brightness and the light are baked in: no brightness grade or sweep overlay on top. 1600x900 at 12 samples, upscaled. screen_quad = the monitor's picture on the last frame. v2.3: superseded by the mug match cut (x_mug_night -> x_mug_dawn); kept for reference.
Drawer 1 (BRAKE PADS) slides open from shut, one pair inside; ends on the approved still's state. Slow push toward the open drawer.
Monday afternoon: the window sun slides slowly across the desk; slow push toward the monitor. Colour as approved (keep the film's AFT grade on top; drop the CSS sweep overlay).

NEW (SHOTLIST 6.1): dusk, Mon 16:08. Held on CAM_medium_monday's frame: a dim blue room, then the desk lamp clicks on at frame 25 (0.5 s after the on-screen start, frame 13) and the room warms; matches 06_medium_dusk from frame 32. 1920x1080, 12 samples. 'replaces' is the nearest old still; start is scene 6's old start.

18:40, Martin gone, lamp off. The monitor (Tuesday's jobs page) dims at frame 99, goes dark at frame 138, then Barnaby's bell glows up in the corner (full by frame 191); the power LEDs go blue -> amber as it sleeps. Ends on the approved still's state. Held. Rendered 1600x900 at 12 samples, upscaled.
